name: Question 11
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/95ffb6bc0645146025fdcb2c1dd628b1793bc12cff0d8cc4891bd5f0a464b496.png)

What multiplication problem is represented by the model above?
worked_solution:
We have $\frac{1}{7}$ on the left and $\frac{5}{7}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129500/assets/2bc0f8cabbf459c88e73adf070dfd1f86f318ec94a441742dc02bd4fa44639da.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\frac{1}{7}\times 5=\frac{5}{7}.
$$
